s02.title: numerical convergence study and tolerance derivation
s02.system: 1 C atom, NC pseudo-dojo PBE C.upf, sphere box, serial
s02.conclusion: Absolute total energies on this mesh family are meaningful only to ~3 mHa (~80 meV) and spacing convergence is non-monotonic. The ETF test ladder must therefore use same-mesh differences (v=0 vs +v vs -v; legacy vs initial_etf vs traveling_pp at identical grid/dt/PP/trajectory), never absolute energies across meshes.
s02.verified_side_finding: Ar.upf: pseudo_type=NC, functional=PBE, z_valence=8.00, l_max=2, number_of_proj=6, core_correction=T, sha256 e366a9edd6ab498b4ffdedccbd021caa0672d9a475c22bbfc28715c3d0649790. Confirms Ar+ has 7 valence electrons for this PP (checked against the file, not assumed).
limits: No Ar+, no CNT, no TDDFT, no ETF, no moving ion simulated.
Non-monotonic spacing convergence is observed, not explained; the jagged-mask hypothesis was not tested.
0.28 mHa box residual is a geometric extrapolation, not a verified bound.
Two parser bugs in the first script version were caught by the script's own failure path and fixed; the bad CSV was discarded.
